description: HTTP server metrics of the OpenTelemetry semantic conventions, from the Kinetica exporter's metric tables.

options.content:
### HTTP services
Request rate, errors and duration per service, from `http.server.request.duration` (a histogram, in seconds) and `http.server.active_requests`. Reads the metric tables the Kinetica exporter writes, in the schema **otel**; for another schema, replace `otel.` in the panel queries. Rates assume cumulative temporality (the default of most SDKs; for delta, run the collector's `deltatocumulative` processor). Each series is averaged per minute.

panels.title: Requests per second
panels.description: Observations of http.server.request.duration per second, per service.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT MSECS_SINCE_EPOCH(bucket) AS time_unix, service, SUM(series_rate) AS requests_per_second
FROM (
    SELECT TIME_BUCKET(60000, time_unix) AS bucket, series_id, service,
           AVG(sample_rate) AS series_rate
    FROM (
        SELECT h.series_id, h.time_unix,
               COALESCE(s.service_name, 'unknown') AS service,
               CAST(CASE WHEN LAG(h.data_count) OVER (PARTITION BY h.series_id ORDER BY h.time_unix) IS NULL THEN NULL
                     WHEN h.data_count >= LAG(h.data_count) OVER (PARTITION BY h.series_id ORDER BY h.time_unix)
                     THEN h.data_count - LAG(h.data_count) OVER (PARTITION BY h.series_id ORDER BY h.time_unix)
                     ELSE h.data_count END AS DOUBLE) * 1000
               / (MSECS_SINCE_EPOCH(h.time_unix)
                  - LAG(MSECS_SINCE_EPOCH(h.time_unix)) OVER (PARTITION BY h.series_id ORDER BY h.time_unix)) AS sample_rate
        FROM otel.metric_histogram_point h
        JOIN (SELECT series_id, service_name, labels FROM otel.metric_series
               WHERE metric_name = 'http.server.request.duration' AND temporality = 2) s
          ON s.series_id = h.series_id
        WHERE h.time_unix BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
    ) d
    WHERE sample_rate IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY TIME_BUCKET(60000, time_unix), series_id, service
) b
GROUP BY bucket, service
ORDER BY bucket, service

panels.title: 5xx responses per second
panels.description: Requests answered with a 5xx status, found with text_match on the series' labels.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT MSECS_SINCE_EPOCH(bucket) AS time_unix, service, SUM(series_rate) AS errors_per_second
FROM (
    SELECT TIME_BUCKET(60000, time_unix) AS bucket, series_id, service,
           AVG(sample_rate) AS series_rate
    FROM (
        SELECT h.series_id, h.time_unix,
               COALESCE(s.service_name, 'unknown') AS service,
               CAST(CASE WHEN LAG(h.data_count) OVER (PARTITION BY h.series_id ORDER BY h.time_unix) IS NULL THEN NULL
                     WHEN h.data_count >= LAG(h.data_count) OVER (PARTITION BY h.series_id ORDER BY h.time_unix)
                     THEN h.data_count - LAG(h.data_count) OVER (PARTITION BY h.series_id ORDER BY h.time_unix)
                     ELSE h.data_count END AS DOUBLE) * 1000
               / (MSECS_SINCE_EPOCH(h.time_unix)
                  - LAG(MSECS_SINCE_EPOCH(h.time_unix)) OVER (PARTITION BY h.series_id ORDER BY h.time_unix)) AS sample_rate
        FROM otel.metric_histogram_point h
        JOIN (SELECT series_id, service_name, labels FROM otel.metric_series
               WHERE metric_name = 'http.server.request.duration' AND temporality = 2
                 AND text_match(labels, 'labels.http.response.status_code:/5../')) s
          ON s.series_id = h.series_id
        WHERE h.time_unix BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
    ) d
    WHERE sample_rate IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY TIME_BUCKET(60000, time_unix), series_id, service
) b
GROUP BY bucket, service
ORDER BY bucket, service

panels.title: Error ratio
panels.description: Share of requests answered with a 5xx status, per service.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT MSECS_SINCE_EPOCH(bucket) AS time_unix, service, SUM(CASE WHEN is_error = 1 THEN series_rate ELSE 0 END) / SUM(series_rate) AS error_ratio
FROM (
    SELECT TIME_BUCKET(60000, time_unix) AS bucket, series_id, service, is_error,
           AVG(sample_rate) AS series_rate
    FROM (
        SELECT h.series_id, h.time_unix,
               COALESCE(s.service_name, 'unknown') AS service,
               CASE WHEN JSON_VALUE(s.labels, '$["http.response.status_code"]') LIKE '5%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_error,
               CAST(CASE WHEN LAG(h.data_count) OVER (PARTITION BY h.series_id ORDER BY h.time_unix) IS NULL THEN NULL
                     WHEN h.data_count >= LAG(h.data_count) OVER (PARTITION BY h.series_id ORDER BY h.time_unix)
                     THEN h.data_count - LAG(h.data_count) OVER (PARTITION BY h.series_id ORDER BY h.time_unix)
                     ELSE h.data_count END AS DOUBLE) * 1000
               / (MSECS_SINCE_EPOCH(h.time_unix)
                  - LAG(MSECS_SINCE_EPOCH(h.time_unix)) OVER (PARTITION BY h.series_id ORDER BY h.time_unix)) AS sample_rate
        FROM otel.metric_histogram_point h
        JOIN (SELECT series_id, service_name, labels FROM otel.metric_series
               WHERE metric_name = 'http.server.request.duration' AND temporality = 2) s
          ON s.series_id = h.series_id
        WHERE h.time_unix BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
    ) d
    WHERE sample_rate IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY TIME_BUCKET(60000, time_unix), series_id, service, is_error
) b
GROUP BY bucket, service
HAVING SUM(series_rate) > 0
ORDER BY bucket, service

panels.title: Mean request duration
panels.description: Increase of the histogram's sum over the increase of its count, per service.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT MSECS_SINCE_EPOCH(bucket) AS time_unix, service, SUM(sum_increase) / SUM(count_increase) AS mean_duration
FROM (
    SELECT TIME_BUCKET(60000, h.time_unix) AS bucket,
           COALESCE(s.service_name, 'unknown') AS service,
           CASE WHEN LAG(h.data_count) OVER (PARTITION BY h.series_id ORDER BY h.time_unix) IS NULL THEN NULL
                     WHEN h.data_count >= LAG(h.data_count) OVER (PARTITION BY h.series_id ORDER BY h.time_unix)
                     THEN h.data_sum - LAG(h.data_sum) OVER (PARTITION BY h.series_id ORDER BY h.time_unix)
                     ELSE h.data_sum END AS sum_increase,
           CASE WHEN LAG(h.data_count) OVER (PARTITION BY h.series_id ORDER BY h.time_unix) IS NULL THEN NULL
                     WHEN h.data_count >= LAG(h.data_count) OVER (PARTITION BY h.series_id ORDER BY h.time_unix)
                     THEN h.data_count - LAG(h.data_count) OVER (PARTITION BY h.series_id ORDER BY h.time_unix)
                     ELSE h.data_count END AS count_increase
    FROM otel.metric_histogram_point h
    JOIN (SELECT series_id, service_name, labels FROM otel.metric_series
               WHERE metric_name = 'http.server.request.duration' AND temporality = 2) s
      ON s.series_id = h.series_id
    WHERE h.time_unix BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
) d
WHERE count_increase > 0
GROUP BY bucket, service
ORDER BY bucket, service

panels.title: Active requests
panels.description: http.server.active_requests, summed over each service's series.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT MSECS_SINCE_EPOCH(bucket) AS time_unix, service, SUM(series_value) AS active_requests
FROM (
    SELECT TIME_BUCKET(60000, p.time_unix) AS bucket,
           p.series_id,
           COALESCE(s.service_name, 'unknown') AS service,
           AVG(p.value) AS series_value
    FROM otel.metric_number_point p
    JOIN (SELECT series_id, service_name, labels FROM otel.metric_series
               WHERE metric_name = 'http.server.active_requests') s
      ON s.series_id = p.series_id
    WHERE p.time_unix BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
    GROUP BY TIME_BUCKET(60000, p.time_unix), p.series_id, COALESCE(s.service_name, 'unknown')
) b
GROUP BY bucket, service
ORDER BY bucket, service

panels.title: Busiest routes
panels.description: Requests, 5xx ratio and mean duration per service and route over the time range.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT service, route,
       SUM(count_increase) AS requests,
       CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN is_error = 1 THEN count_increase ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE) / SUM(count_increase) AS error_ratio,
       SUM(sum_increase) / SUM(count_increase) AS mean_duration
FROM (
    SELECT COALESCE(s.service_name, 'unknown') AS service,
           COALESCE(NULLIF(JSON_VALUE(s.labels, '$["http.route"]'), ''), '(none)') AS route,
           CASE WHEN JSON_VALUE(s.labels, '$["http.response.status_code"]') LIKE '5%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_error,
           CASE WHEN LAG(h.data_count) OVER (PARTITION BY h.series_id ORDER BY h.time_unix) IS NULL THEN NULL
                     WHEN h.data_count >= LAG(h.data_count) OVER (PARTITION BY h.series_id ORDER BY h.time_unix)
                     THEN h.data_sum - LAG(h.data_sum) OVER (PARTITION BY h.series_id ORDER BY h.time_unix)
                     ELSE h.data_sum END AS sum_increase,
           CASE WHEN LAG(h.data_count) OVER (PARTITION BY h.series_id ORDER BY h.time_unix) IS NULL THEN NULL
                     WHEN h.data_count >= LAG(h.data_count) OVER (PARTITION BY h.series_id ORDER BY h.time_unix)
                     THEN h.data_count - LAG(h.data_count) OVER (PARTITION BY h.series_id ORDER BY h.time_unix)
                     ELSE h.data_count END AS count_increase
    FROM otel.metric_histogram_point h
    JOIN (SELECT series_id, service_name, labels FROM otel.metric_series
               WHERE metric_name = 'http.server.request.duration' AND temporality = 2) s
      ON s.series_id = h.series_id
    WHERE h.time_unix BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
) d
WHERE count_increase > 0
GROUP BY service, route
ORDER BY requests DESC
LIMIT 25

panels.title: Slowest exemplars
panels.description: The exemplars of http.server.request.duration with the largest values; look their trace_id up in the trace tables.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT e.time_unix AS point_time_unix, e.value AS duration, COALESCE(s.service_name, 'unknown') AS service,
       JSON_VALUE(s.labels, '$["http.route"]') AS route, e.trace_id, e.span_id
FROM otel.metric_exemplar e
JOIN (SELECT series_id, service_name, labels FROM otel.metric_series
               WHERE metric_name = 'http.server.request.duration') s
  ON s.series_id = e.series_id
WHERE e.time_unix BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
ORDER BY e.value DESC
LIMIT 25
